scope: Proposition 8.1 of the manuscript “Nonuniqueness with local conservation for the hard-sphere Boltzmann equation” (preprints/Nonuniqueness-with-local-conservation-for-the-hard-sphere-Boltzmann-equation-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 363 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 640850bc08703544), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 39. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix the construction parameters supplied by Proposition 7.4, and let bN → ∞. Either the dormant family, or a family of cap solutions at one fixed horizon T ∈ (0, T0], has a subsequence of total densities FN converging weakly in L1([0, τ] × Ω) for every τ < ∞ to a nonnegative density F. This subsequence can be chosen so that FN (t) ⇀ F(t) in L1(Ω) at every t ≥ 0, with uniformly small polynomially weighted velocity tails on each bounded time interval. The limit has initial datum F0 and is a global entropy solution obeying local conservation in the sense of Definition 1.1. More precisely, F ∈ C([0, ∞); L1 (Ω)), Z τ 0 Z Ω ⟨v⟩k F +Q+ (F, F)+Q− (F, F)  dx dv dt < ∞ (k ≥ 0, τ < ∞). (8.1) Total mass, momentum, and energy are conserved at every time. The common early-time pointwise majorant of the dormant approximations also bounds any dormant limit.
